recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future modernization of the current Guide to Resources taxonomy headings should be handled as a separate current-spec editorial issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-I clarification asking to fix inactive Guide to Resources category links, align list labels and headings, correct Financial/Infrastructure ordering, and change the Conformance description from 'use' to 'used'.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 12795, represented by git commit 334f96066539f6f3d32b244d16a0afd163267954 (#12894 - remove dead links), which removed the defective six-section ordered list from source/resourceguide.html and replaced it with a Resource List pointer.
additional_context: Current source/resourceguide.html still presents Guide to Resources and is linked from active narrative pages including source/documentation.html, source/modules.html, source/overview-dev.html, and source/resourcelist.html. The old list and its dead category links are absent. Jira search found only the seed issue, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current page no longer contains the paragraph that FHIR-12894 targeted, and reintroducing or retaxonomizing the old list would be broader than the applied issue.
